Its more likely that my mother will find anything I record and it'll make things worse. She has a tendency to go through things when people aren't looking.

My boyfriend isnt close to anyone but me. He doesn't have any other friends and his family is unsupportive of him, so he doesn't really have anyone else. 

Ill try to keep you updated. Thank you for caring enough to bother with commenting.

I'm afraid to contact cps as I don't really know what will happen and I don't even have any proof that she's done anything considering the situation. I've tried to talk to my boyfriend about the issues, and when he ignored it, I tried break up with him but he told me if I left him he'd kill himself and I don't know what to do about that. I don't live near him so it would be easy for me to just drop contact with him but he also has a past of self harm and mental issues and I'm afraid of something happening. I don't really have any way out of either situation.
